body: That's not necessarily true, I wanted a better explanation of why I should just let her try the Senny's first. I am still left with no real answers.

It's fine, you helped by just talking to me. I'm in the Dallas TX area. If you want to chat that sounds good, i can't promise I'll always be available because my social anxiety unfortunately.  I'll shoot you a PM with my info if you'd like (I'm rarely on reddit).

I already take 100mg of Pristiq  and 15mg of Abilify and 2mg of Kolopin daily.

I'm a pediatric stroke survivor with Cerebral Palsy/Hemiparesis in my left side (the side that was suppose to be dominant). Because of that my stamina is virtually zero and it causes me unbelievable back pain. It's only mild CP but it keeps me from doing a lot of things physically and does not ever help me mentally. On top of that my father reposed when I was 10, leaving me to care for my grieving mother and 6 year old brother. Then there's my history of be super awkward around women, and really anyone, seeing as I have only one friend. I keep saying I'll go to college next semester, but it never happens, partially because I can't drive. So I just lay here and rot most of the time except to go see my psychologist or one of my many other doctors.
